name: TransLink static feed
check: Read feed date and archive permalink; compare named rail patterns, stops and shapes if changed. Never interpret a future feed or a temporary outage as an opening/closure.

name: TransLink newsroom
check: Search TransLink releases, The Buzzer and Mayors’ Council minutes for SkyTrain-specific decisions and openings.

name: Broadway Subway project office
check: Read linked new notices and the construction-notice archive; include meaningful works, not repeated traffic text.

name: Surrey Langley project office
check: Check the notice archive, advisories, station and alignment pages. Also search Dave Barrett Extension.

name: B.C. government news
check: Search the releases for SkyTrain, Broadway Subway, Dave Barrett Extension, Surrey Langley, UBC and Newton.

name: Surrey council
check: Search council decisions and budget motions on King George Boulevard. Distinguish Newton SkyTrain from BRT.

name: Port Coquitlam
check: Search council reports and press releases for business plan, spur and financing. A tail track is not a passenger branch.

name: UBC extension and Vancouver
check: Also check Vancouver council for the regional base scope, Cambie infill, and project decisions.

name: Burrard Inlet studies
check: Check North Shore Connects and Metro Vancouver municipalities. Explicit SkyTrain study cases only; keep mode-undecided programs off the map.

name: Local coverage discovery
check: Search Daily Hive, CBC British Columbia, CityNews Vancouver or North Shore News for new coverage. Read the article and check underlying authority. A publisher homepage alone is not a successful discovery pass.
